steps.content: Once upon a time...
...No, wait. I don't think this is the past.
Maybe... the distant future?
Hmm... that doesn't feel right either...
Ahh, whatever! Anyway, this is DisCity.
A place of desire, dreams, and hope...
[Scene Change: Bureau]

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: No wonder everyone says MBCC is blessed by fortune. Remote as it is, this place works miracles.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: You know, it's funny... Data we couldn't coax out of our instruments back at the institute is just flowing in here. A few more readings like this, and we'll hit our annual targets ahead of schedule!
The research supervisor beckons to the students behind him, his face brimming with undisguised delight, yet the students themselves seem at a loss.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: What's with the long faces? Oh, I know the successful experiment's got everyone buzzing, but let's not forget our manners. Hurry, Chief's waiting for us.
Still, no one stirs. The assistant standing nearby can no longer stomach the silence and, steeling himself, finally speaks up in a low voice.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: ...Supervisor, you told us before we came that there was a walking disaster living here. You said not to bring any of our latest prototypes...

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: If that Summer girl catches wind of it, who knows what'll happen... Years of work could be gone.
Just thinking of that pink-haired girl who had blazed through the Ring Research Institute's record books two years ago was enough to make the supervisor's mouth twitch uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: Tsk... ahem... Well, what about something else then? Tell me you didn't come completely empty-handed.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: We... we did bring something. It's in good shape. But it's also one of our experimental materials...

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Giving it to the Chief is fine, I just... without it, if something goes wrong with the experiment...

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: What's the probability of failure?

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Simulations put it at roughly <color=#fb9259>0.00000532%</color>.

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: Then let's give it to them. That's a hundred times less likely than a pedestrian getting hit by a car in Eastside. It <color=#fb9259>won't</color> happen.
From his pocket, the assistant produces a coin-like object and slips it discreetly into the supervisor's waiting palm.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: You'll have to forgive my students. Hopeless bookworms, the lot of them. Not an ounce of field experience between them. Terribly sorry for the awkward showing!

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: Now then! This is the Ring Research Institute's most prized achievement in recent months. Though I'll admit... compared to what a certain genius can whip up, it's little more than a trinket, haha... But please, accept it as a token of our goodwill!

options: I'm not gonna get captured for this later, am I?

steps.content: He presses the coin into your palm with grave ceremony, his fingers trembling faintly from sheer, overflowing enthusiasm.

steps.speaker: Ring Research Supervisor
steps.content: This is no ordinary coin; it's a core simulation medium, refined through countless sleepless nights and massive computational resources at the Ring Research Institute! It stands as a symbol of the unbreakable bond between our Institute and the Bureau.
[Scene Change: CG 1]
Here lives an office worker in DisCity, leading an utterly unremarkable life.
But he was once known as the Sinner Detention Expert, Black Ring Purifier, Syndicate Crime-Fighting Pioneer, and Eastside's Model Youth.
steps.female_content: But she was once known as the Sinner Detention Expert, Black Ring Purifier, Syndicate Crime-Fighting Pioneer, and Eastside's Model Youth.

steps.content: For him, such insincere pleasantries and evasive small talk have become nothing more than the most unremarkable routine.
steps.female_content: For her, such insincere pleasantries and evasive small talk have become nothing more than the most unremarkable routine.

steps.content: CG 1
Once you step out of the Bureau and confirm no one is around, you finally let out a heavy, bone-deep sigh.
Though DisCity has seen no abnormal activity of late, the joint project between the MBCC and the Ring Research Institute has been wearing you down to the marrow.

You have been stretched to your limit, caught between the construction crew lamenting, "Chief, we really can't tear down that load-bearing wall," and placating the Institute's persistent demands: "Why can't we install a miniature Ring substance collider here?"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And of course, the real backbone of Bureau life is endless chores...

It took you a solid month, but you finally renovated one of the Bureau's above-ground laboratories to Ring Research Institute specifications. That, however, was just the beginning. Layers of bureaucracy and a web of competing interests have since bled you dry. You honestly think you'd rather wade into a Mania zone and face the Corruptors head-on.

If it had been the year you first woke up, you might still have felt a spark of excitement. After all, this was a collaboration with the Ring Research Institute, something most people would never get to touch in their lifetime.
But now, only one thought occupies your mind:

options: "...If only I could have something sweet to eat."

steps.content: You fidget with the friendship commemorative coin the Ring Research Institute had pressed upon you, your fingers unconsciously unlocking your terminal. The screen lands on a food delivery page, and as your eyes skim the promotional text, something stirs faintly in your chest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's been so long since I've ordered delivery. I've almost forgotten what food from outside the Bureau even tastes like. Just <color=#fb9259>this once</color> won't hurt, right?
It takes you a long moment to dredge up the Bureau's receiving address from memory, and after a brief hesitation, you settle on a milk tea at seventy percent sweetness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That'll do. Twenty minutes. Might as well call it a small celebration... for temporarily escaping overtime hell.
But even the most ordinary routines... need a little spice.
It could be sweet, bitter, sour... or perhaps, vibrant, colorful, and utterly unexpected.
[Scene Change: Car Interior]
In the driver's seat, a pair of hands wraps around the steering wheel, frozen in a vise-like hold.
No no no!! This can't be happening!! It was totally fine yesterday! How did it just break today?!

steps.speaker: Car Navigation
steps.content: Warning. Current speed: <color=#fb9259>80 kilometers</color> per hour. You are exceeding the speed limit. Please slow down.
I know, I know!! The brakes are literally dead! What am I supposed to do, yell at it to stop?!!!
Somebody do something!! I'm about to become a pancake on the streets of DisCity!! I haven't even delivered my three-thousand-word confession essay yet and I spent so long on it!!

steps.speaker: Car Navigation
steps.content: External equipment malfunction detected. Initiating autonomous driving protocol.
Watching the onboard AI finally take the reins of this chaotic situation, the person in the driver's seat feels her frayed nerves loosen ever so slightly.
Oh thank god... That was way too close. Like, way too close. Who knew turning yourself in came with a near-death experience?
No sooner does the tension ease than the navigation system crackles back to life, delivering a message she desperately wishes she had not heard.

steps.speaker: Car Navigation
steps.content: Connection failed. Braking system physically damaged. Autonomous driving unavailable.

steps.speaker: Car Navigation
steps.content: Driver, abandon vehicle immediately. Thank you for choosing our autonomous driving service.
The sheer panic sends the driver's mind into a momentary blank, and in her daze, her foot presses down on the accelerator again.

steps.speaker: Car Navigation
steps.content: Current speed: <color=#fb9259>100 kilometers</color> per hour. You are exceeding the speed limit by a significant amount. Please slow down immediately.
I said stop telling me that! Somebody help meeeee!!
[Scene Change: CG 1, 2, 3]
Barely five minutes after you tap the order button, just as you're making your way to the Bureau's delivery receiving point—
Car Sound Effect

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Since when does food delivery in DisCity arrive this fast?
Before the thought can even finish forming, before your fingers find the terminal to check the delivery person's location, blinding headlights flood your eyes.

Then the roar of an engine swallows everything. A car, its chassis vomiting sparks, cleaves through the MBCC gate with an almost surreal trajectory. The barrier pinwheels into the air, tracing an arc against the night.
Hey!! Out of the way!! Move, move, move!!!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Huh?
In this split-second, honed by countless brushes with death, your dynamic vision sharpens to an almost supernatural degree.
You see it with terrible clarity: the car tracing a flawless, inescapable ballistic arc through the air.
And its landing point is the very patch of ground beneath your feet.
In the chaos, the Ring Research Institute's commemorative coin is flung skyward at the same time, spinning into the night.
[Black Screen]
[Explosion, Screen Shakes]
[Scene Change]
You force your leaden eyelids open and give yourself a cursory once-over, checking that everything is still where it should be.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank goodness...
Not a mark on you. No lacerations, no bruises, no lingering imprint of the collision. Your body is, against all reason, perfectly whole; even your shackles obey without hesitation.
...Hold on! But that's exactly what's wrong.

A direct hit from a speeding car should, by all logic, have left you a corpse. So how are you still standing here without so much as a scrape...? Did you doze off at your desk and dream the whole thing?
You pinch your cheek. It stings. Not a dream, then.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...So where am I, exactly?
You lift your gaze. Above you is neither the familiar ceiling of the MBCC nor the harsh fluorescent glare of the Eastside hospital.
Instead... a dim, murky void stretches overhead.

Did it happen again? Summoned to some unknown space, just like before? Is someone about to pop up and announce, "Congratulations, you've been transported to another world!"? Because that would be exactly the kind of cliché straight out of those manga EMP is always reading.
Just as you're swiftly piecing the situation together, light footsteps echo from somewhere in the darkness, and a blinding light floods the space.
[CG: Murphy and Chief Meet]
A girl with a shock of fiery red hair stands silhouetted against the light, gazing down at you.
Your eyes meet. For a moment, the air seems to freeze.
Welcome to Otherworld, Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wow, we're going with the most cliché setup possible?!
